title: Cursor MCP Setup Guide: Connect Your Agent to Real Infrastructure
summary: Learn how to add MCP servers to Cursor in 2026 — global vs project config, stdio vs HTTP transport, the Blink plugin, and fixes for the 9 most common issues.
body_markdown: Yes. Put` .cursor/mcp.json` in your project root and commit it to source control. Every teammate who opens the project in Cursor gets the same server setup automatically. Don't hardcode secrets in the committed file — use environment variable references or a secrets manager, and document the required env vars in your README.
